name: Murakumo Ryuuji
source: [url=/c17268]Shotarou's[/url] best friend, they've been friends ever since they entered high school on the first day. Compared to Shotarou, he takes his studies seriously, is regarded as the "academy's hot guy", and is better at sports than him. He dislikes people who judge others based on their looks.
